judgments.description:
Current opening: 'Skyvern's REST API lives at `https://api.skyvern.com/v1`. Every request must include your API key in the `x-api-key` header.'

What's missing: The opening jumps straight into configuration details without explaining WHAT the API reference covers or WHY a developer would use it. There's no statement of purpose — nothing tells the reader what they can accomplish with the API or that this page is their complete reference for all available endpoints and capabilities.

Suggested stronger opening sentence: 'This page is the complete reference for Skyvern's REST API — covering every endpoint you need to create, monitor, and manage browser automation tasks programmatically.'
